description.value:
You've learned how to strike a good deal. Your Charisma score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You have advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) and Charisma (Deception) checks made while haggling or trading, and you can always gauge the current market value of an unenhanced item or a common enhanced item. Whenever you identify an item, you also learn a rough estimate of its worth.
